a.xlink:title: Sets up a group background and optional exclusive button grouping.
Suppresses a grouped widget's background unless it declares a sunken or raised base.
Configures a widget and its descendants for a shared group background.
Returns the shared style, creating it when application lifetime permits.
Installs a filter to configure children added later.
Makes an eligible push or tool button checkable and adds it to the supplied group.
Returns whether the widget is inside a group base.
Disables automatic background filling and makes the Base palette brush transparent.
Loads the bundled JetBrains Mono fonts once.
Excludes action-managed tool buttons from automatic button grouping.
